summary: New Google Cloud customers get $300 in free credits to spend on any Cloud Platform service during a 90-day trial window counted from signup. A billing account is created, but you are not charged until you manually upgrade.
claim_steps: Sign in with or create a Google account.
Complete the signup steps and create a billing account (no automatic charges).
Use the $300 credits on eligible services within the 90-day window.

social_proof.title: Free Google Cloud features and trial offer | Google Cloud Free Program | Google Cloud Documentation
social_proof.text: Learn about Google Cloud's free offerings and free trials, plus how to upgrade your account.
